items.title: 14.12 Hawa ke mayar ke bare mein hypothesis parakhne ke tajurbe aur data jama karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.12, printed page 317.

blocks.text: Air quality ke bare mein kisi hypothesis (andaza jise test kiya jaye) ko jaanchne ke liye experiment design karna, ehtiyat se planning, data jama karne aur us ke analysis (jaiza) par mushtamil hai. Air quality ke liye yeh steps kiye jate hain:

Pehle step mein experiment design karne ke liye ek hypothesis banai jati hai. Misal: “Shehri ilaqon mein hawa ke particulate matter (PM 2.5) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) ki concentration rush (peak) traffic ke auqat mein baqi auqat se zyada hoti hai.” Is hypothesis ko din ke mukhtalif auqat mein air quality ka data jama kar ke test kiya ja sakta hai.

Experiment ki tafseel plan ki jati hai, jaise variables (badalne wali cheezein) aur data jama karne ka tareeqa. Monitoring ke liye masroof sarkon ki jagahein aur rihaishi (residential) ilaqe chune jate hain.

Rush hours aur non-rush hours mein traffic ki miqdar ka data jama kiya jata hai aur aakhir mein muqabla (compare) kiya jata hai. Air quality ka data jama karne ke liye qabil-e-bharosa (reliable) instruments aur tareeqe istemal kiye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek experiment design karein jo yeh jaanche ke bhatti (brick kiln) ke qareeb PM2.5 us jagah se zyada hai ya nahi jo hawa ke rukh ke ulat 2 km door hai.
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis: bhatti ke qareeb PM2.5 zyada hai. Do jagahein chunein: ek bhatti se 200 m hawa ke rukh par aur ek 2 km ulat taraf, dono ek hi oonchai par. Dono jagah ek jaisa calibrated PM sensor ya nephelometer lagayein; do hafte rozana ek hi auqat par readings lein, hawa ka rukh aur bhatti ke chalne ka record rakhein; phir dono jagahon ki average readings ka muqabla karein.

items: Air quality ki hypothesis test karna: hypothesis banayein (rush hours mein PM2.5 aur NO₂ zyada); experiment design karein (variables, jagahein); data jama kar ke muqabla karein.
